_doc: Environment and build manifest of release v1.1.0. It records the build of the production binary, the other two binaries behind the paper's runs, the GATE patch, the hashes of the positronium physics sources (as shipped, as in v1.0.1, and as compiled into the production binary) with the object-file evidence that links them, the material-database hashes and every runtime switch the physics reads. Hashes of files in this release can be checked with sha256sum. Workstation paths are written relative to <project>, the project tree of the build machine.

production_binary.build_tree_copy_note: same size, differs only because cmake --install rewrites the RPATH
production_binary.rebuilds_from_this_release_have_other_ha: A Gate built from this release cannot carry the hash e37be8b4. The binary embeds absolute RPATHs of the build machine, and it also contains G4PickOffAtRestModel, a compiled but never-referenced class that is not shipped. A build of this release with the production configuration on the production machine gave sha256 60f31ce34250fbbcababeb3386af63c64ca92fe8a827cc3b4d41d2c8765f792b. Equivalence is shown at the level of the object files instead (physics_sources.object_identity).

build.ui_vis: Geant4 Qt UI and OpenGL/Qt visualisation compiled in (G4UI_USE_QT, G4VIS_USE_OPENGLQT)

nlohmann_json.production: non-amalgamated 3.12.0 top header in the GATE tree, whose detail/ headers came from the system package (Arch nlohmann-json 3.12.0-2)
nlohmann_json.evidence: PLIMaterialLoader.cc, the only file that includes it, compiles to the same object file with either header (object_identity)

build.no_dynamic_pli_library: Gate links no libPLICustomPhysics. The physics is compiled into GateLib from source/physics/ (integration/install_into_gate.sh)

patch.equals_production_tree: byte-identical to git diff HEAD of the production GATE tree (and of the in-flight tree)
patch.statement: GATE was patched. One change makes the physics list selectable by name, and the other ten were made so that GATE 9.4.1 builds and runs with GCC 15, CMake 4 and Geant4 11.3.2. None of them changes the simulated physics. Geant4 itself was not patched.

files.source/digits_hits/src/GateOutputMgr.cc: null checks on the analysis/fastanalysis output modules, and two /vis calls disabled (crash guards)
files.source/digits_hits/src/GateToRoot.cc: empty-container checks at end of acquisition (crash guard)

geant4_version.build_check: GATE's CMakeLists.txt calls FIND_PACKAGE(Geant4 REQUIRED) without a version and only prints a warning for 11.3
geant4_version.warning_printed: Warning! This GATE version is not validated for Geant4 11.3 distribution. Please use Geant4 11.2 distribution instead.
geant4_version.statement: The combination builds and runs with the patch above, but it is outside GATE's validated matrix.

3522d567.note: archived build used from 2026-08-14 14:54 until the production build of 2026-08-19 20:19. No source snapshot was kept, so it cannot be rebuilt or compared at object level

cc552a68.note: in-flight annihilation variant: the production configuration and sources with integration/variants/gate-inflight-stock.patch applied (variant)

other_binaries.earlier_builds: runs before 2026-08-14 14:54 used builds that were not retained

physics_sources.shipped_note: The code is that of v1.0.1. Two comment lines were added at the top (SPDX licence identifier and copyright), and in the comments of 12 files em dashes and semicolons were replaced by colons, commas, parentheses or periods. Stripping comments from a shipped file and from its v1.0.1 version gives the same text, and the release build gives the object files listed under object_identity.
physics_sources.as_compiled_note: These are the project files that GATE compiled (the production GATE tree holds symlinks to them). G4PositroniumAnnihilation.cc and G4PsAtRestProcess.cc were edited on 2026-08-24, after the production build, so the bytes compiled on 2026-08-19 are not on disk. The in-flight build of 2026-09-30 compiled the present files with the same flags, and its objects are byte-identical to the production objects (object_identity). The project files and the shipped files differ only in comments, log and exception message text, the name of one file-static variable (g_lastEventID -> g_lastTrackID), one parameter name and the override keyword. The project copy of PLIPhysicsList.cc also names a private planning note in a comment, which is why it is not the shipped text.

not_shipped.note: compiled into e37be8b4 (object sha256 85102b8edcb564387f1bd531000caf673ac5023aafd98867d4f6b640dac5a57c) but referenced by no code

object_identity.method: Objects of CMakeFiles/GateLib.dir/source/physics/src/ compared by sha256. production = the build of e37be8b4. inflight_build = the 2026-09-30 build of cc552a68 from the present project files. release_build = a 2026-10-20 build of this release (integration/install_into_gate.sh into GATE 2d03a89b, the configuration above, same machine).

result.G4PositroniumAnnihilation.cc.o: differs. objdump -d -r of the two: same number of disassembly lines (5606), 6 differing lines: 2 string-length immediates of exception message text, and 4 disassembler annotations (two name the renamed file-static g_lastEventID, two name a nearby label) whose target offsets are the same
result.G4PsAtRestProcess.cc.o: differs. objdump -d -r: same number of disassembly lines (5617), 2 differing lines, both string-length immediates of message text
result.PLIOrePowell.cc.o: differs. objdump -d -r: same number of disassembly lines (2540), 2 differing lines, both string-length immediates of the two reworded log messages
result.inflight_build_vs_production: all identical except PLIPhysicsList.cc.o, the intended variant

object_identity.variant: custom_physics/src/PLIPhysicsList.cc of this release with integration/variants/gate-inflight-stock.patch applied, compiled with the production flags, gives 6202934c03c1fb20d0697ec4618395ce76709a353da0c1e8d70118c83c0e30d6, byte-identical to PLIPhysicsList.cc.o of the cc552a68 build
object_identity.conclusion: the shipped physics sources are code-equivalent to the physics compiled into e37be8b4 and cc552a68

variant.physics_level_test: integration/variants/pli_inflight_test built from this release reproduces the CSV output of the production test binary byte for byte (3000 44Sc positrons, seed 401, modes pli, hybrid and stock)

materials_database.v8_vs_v7_at_run_time: only the five TumorTissue_pO2_* entries differ (by at most 0.11 ps). k_O2 2.45e-5 -> 2.5704e-5, provenance fields added (materials/PROVENANCE.md)
materials_database.variants_note: lookup_baseline.json and r2a_equal_tau_materials.json lack I3_convention on some entries and cannot be loaded by this release
materials_database.closure_database: 2a26b68e..., used by the O4 reruns of 2026-08-14 to 16 (calibration closure, brain tumour, VIP-Man era). Not retained, not in this release

removed_since_v1_0_1.note: version 7 with reworded provenance text, numerically equal to materials/previous/

materials_database.as_used_note: The released database files differ from the files the runs used only in the free-text "comment" field of the XAD4_water entry, which the loader does not read: one phrase was reworded for the release. Every lifetime, yield, radius, oxygen, convention and alias entry is identical. as_used_sha256 gives the hashes of the files the runs used, which the paper, simulation/RUNS.json, simulation/README.md and the registration records quote.

gate_material_files.note: materials_pli.db as of 2026-08-22 (XAD-4 densities 0.67 g/cm3). Runs before that date loaded the earlier densities

excluded_inputs_sha256._note: not in the release (simulation/README.md, 'Inputs you must supply'). Hashes of the files used, so that copies obtained from the authors can be checked

PLI_MATERIALS_JSON.default: unset: the loader tries materials/pli_materials.json, ../materials/, ../../materials/ and ../../../materials/ relative to the working directory, and stops if none exists
PLI_MATERIALS_JSON.effect: path of the positronium materials database

PLI_LIFETIME_LOG.default: unset (no per-annihilation records). runner/run_gate_parallel.sh sets it to 1 for every shard unless the caller exports another value
PLI_LIFETIME_LOG.effect: 1 = one PLI_LIFETIME:<delay_ns>:<material>:<x>:<y>:<z>:<time_ns> record per annihilation on stdout

PLI_DIRECT_TAU_PS.default: unset or <= 0: direct annihilation is instantaneous
PLI_DIRECT_TAU_PS.effect: mean lifetime in ps of the exponential delay given to direct annihilation (C2, C1/NEMA 388 ps and the Mercolli replication use 388)

PLI_DISABLE_3GAMMA.default: unset: three-photon o-Ps decay on, P(3 gamma) = tau_eff / PLI_TAU_3GAMMA_NS

PLI_LIFETIME_MODE.default: transport (lifetime and yield of the material where the positron stops)
PLI_LIFETIME_MODE.effect: source = material where the positron was emitted, fixed = PLI_FIXED_TAU_NS everywhere, any other value warns and uses transport

PLI_ALLOW_MATERIAL_FALLBACK.default: unset or 0: a material absent from the database stops the run
PLI_ALLOW_MATERIAL_FALLBACK.effect: non-zero integer = warn and use tau 2.0 ns and the scalar formation probability 0.35 for such a material

PLI_TAU_3GAMMA_NS.effect: vacuum o-Ps three-photon lifetime in ns

PLI_FIXED_TAU_NS.effect: lifetime in ns used when PLI_LIFETIME_MODE=fixed

PLI_LOG_XMAT.effect: 1 = one PLI_R2 record per annihilation carrying the emission and the annihilation material

PLI_INFLIGHT_STOCK.default: unset or not 1: identical to the shipped physics list (stock annihilation removed)
PLI_INFLIGHT_STOCK.effect: 1 = keep Geant4's annihil process for in-flight annihilation and deactivate only its AtRest part

runtime_switches_verified: the set above equals every getenv("PLI_...") and EnvDouble("PLI_...") call in custom_physics/src and custom_physics/include (and the variant patch)
